recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add Timing.text for FHIR-13941 unless a future work-group decision changes the established Timing.code.text approach.
issue_request: FHIR-13941 requested adding Timing.text so complex timing instructions could be exchanged as text alongside encoded timing. It was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: use Timing.code.text and add examples/documentation instead of adding a new Timing element.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to SVN revision 12468, represented by git commit 08d6b08d14dacdd6187f73f62986a6d9ec0ac346, which added Timing.code.text narrative and an inline JSON example. The current Timing spreadsheet defines Timing.code as CodeableConcept and explicitly allows text in code.text.
additional_context: FHIR-5950 had already introduced Timing.code as CodeableConcept for text/coded timing representation. FHIR-20671 later reinforced the same no-new-element approach by moving the Timing.code.text guidance before the examples table and already has a combined-branch audit commit. FHIR-53411 later removed an inaccurate sentence from the same Timing narrative while preserving the Timing.code.text guidance. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source already conveys the requested capability through source/datatypes.html and source/datatypes/timing.xml, and adding a separate Timing.text element would contradict the Jira resolution.
